title: The Request of the Heavenly Eye
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji stepped through that forbidden door from which no one had ever emerged alive, what he did not know was that somewhere, a being that had waited for ten thousand years was revealing its first smile in the darkness.

text.content: The characters of the Tianji Record seared into his soul like a branding iron, each stroke carrying the weight of a thousand jun. He finally understood—the so-called ability to foresee the future was nothing more than Heavenly Fate borrowed from him by the Tianji Record; and every glimpse of heavenly secrets was overdrafting his already scarce lifespan. A bitter smile tugged at the corners of his lips. Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. In the darkness, only the fragment page on his chest emitted a cold, ghostly light. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul within the first page trembled slightly, like a sigh, like helplessness.

"The price has been paid, the contract is sealed." Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed from an ancient time. "But I must remind you—the Tianji Record's complete form, what you've seen is merely the tip of the iceberg. Its true master..." Before he could finish, the void surrounding Chen Ji suddenly violently trembled. It was an indescribable sense of pressure, as if the entire heavens and earth were collapsing towards him. His pupils constricted—not from fear, but from an emotion more primal than fear: reverence. A consciousness so vast and boundless was awakening from the endless abyss.

dialogue.content: "...Finally, someone can hear my voice." The voice did not come from his ears but exploded directly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. It was not language, yet it surpassed all language—each word carried the authority of Heavenly Law. Chen Ji's spine instantly rigidified. Beneath the mask of a废物 disciple, that heart as calm as an abyss began to beat violently for the first time.

text.content: He saw it. Deep within his Mental Sea, an eye was slowly opening. It was not an eye of flesh and blood, but a primordial manifestation woven from countless Heavenly Laws. It was too immense—Chen Ji could not perceive its full form. All he could see was the reflection of countless worlds within that pupil: celestial realms falling, dynasties rising and crumbling. The Heavenly Eye. That legendary will of Heaven, supposedly long perished, had in fact never died—merely been imprisoned somewhere!

dialogue.content: "Do not be alarmed." The voice was平静得近乎冷漠. "You and I are not enemies—at least, not now." Chen Ji forced himself to composure. On that废物 disciple's face appeared a perfectly crafted expression of terror, his voice trembling slightly: "Heavenly... Senior... Why are you in my Mental Sea?" He acted so perfectly. But the Heavenly Eye seemed indifferent to his disguise.

"The Tianji Record is my prison, yet also the sole bridge between you and me." The vast eye turned slightly, as if examining the fragment page within Chen Ji. "Ten thousand years ago, I was betrayed by my own creation and imprisoned in the Nine Abysses. Day after day, I watched those chess pieces I had enlightened—the so-called prophets—walk towards destruction, yet was powerless to intervene." Chen Ji's pupils narrowed slightly: "Creation... The Tianji Record was created by you?"

text.content: "Yes and no." The Heavenly Eye's answer was deliberately ambiguous. "The Tianji Record was originally one of the fundamental laws governing Heaven's运作. I materialized it, hoping to glimpse further into the future... only to be bound by it instead." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently within the Tianji Record, yet remained silent. Chen Ji keenly caught this silence. In his heart, he coldly laughed: So it seemed Mo Xiansheng knew far more than him. But this was not the time for interrogation.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." The Heavenly Eye spoke his name for the first time, each word carrying the resonance of Heavenly Law. "I have a request." The countless worlds and stars within that vast pupil suddenly stilled, as if the entire universe was awaiting Chen Ji's answer. "Help me break free from my shackles. In exchange—I can tell you how to break this chess game."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart violently contracted. Break the chess game—was this not precisely the answer he had been seeking? From废物 disciple to covert chess player, every step he had taken was not an attempt to break free from that invisible hand? However... He recalled the words on the Tianji Record: Every use of foresight ability consumes 5 points of Heavenly Fate. He recalled those prophets who had perished from exhausting their Heavenly Fate. He recalled Chen Nian—his missing sister, taken by the Holy Sect as a "Heavenly Fate Lock Key." All clues pointed to a chilling possibility.

"What does the Senior wish me to do?" Chen Ji's voice regained its composure, and within those seemingly panicked eyes, countless thoughts were rapidly spinning. The Heavenly Eye seemed quite pleased with his reaction. "In the deepest part of the Nine Abysses, there is a seal I set myself. The key to this seal is divided into three pieces, scattered among the three major Sects. As long as you gather the three keys, I shall be free."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye proposed a deal, yet Chen Ji's heart was filled with doubts—why would an ancient expert from ten thousand years ago request help from a mere Foundation Building废物 disciple? Was there some hidden scheme within?

choices.description: Do not immediately agree or refuse—first test the Heavenly Eye's bottom line. How much truth is it willing to reveal? What will happen after it is freed?
choices.visible_cost: Consume time, may provoke the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Gain more information, reduce decision-making risk
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may grow impatient, shortening the deal window

dialogue.content: "Dare I speak boldly—when the Senior has been imprisoned in the Nine Abysses for ten thousand years, with countless Sects standing tall and experts flourishing, why have you singled me out?" Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze直视 that abyss-like pupil. "This junior is merely a废物 at Foundation Building stage—how could I possibly have the ability to break the shackles the Senior has been unable to shake for ten thousand years?"

choices.description: First let the Heavenly Eye demonstrate its sincerity—for example, tell him the truth about the chess game first, or provide some form of guarantee, before considering cooperation
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as greedy, anger the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Gain key intelligence or bargaining chips for survival
choices.risk_hint: Conspiring with the tiger—must have a retreat path

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, a hesitant expression surfacing on his face: "Please do not blame the Senior for this junior's doubts. It's just that... if this junior helps the Senior escape, what is the cost? What are the risks? This junior knows nothing." He paused, his voice dropping several degrees. "As the saying goes, any deal must have some form of guarantee."

"You are quite clever."

There was no anger in the Heavenly Eye's voice, but rather a hint of... appreciation?

"For ten thousand years, every prophet who obtained the Tianji Record Fragment has been reverent and servile. Only you dared to negotiate with me."

The stars within that pupil began slowly rotating, as if contemplating.

"Very well. I will give you an answer—killing me will not awaken your companion."

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

These words were like a basin of ice water poured over his head. He thought of those "awakened" prophets—they believed that killing the previous holder of the Tianji Record would grant them freedom, only to turn to ash after a brief flash of light.

So that was it.

Killing the Heavenly Eye would not liberate the pawns it controlled. Instead, it would cause higher beings to deem the "pawns useless" and initiate a reset program.

By then, not just the prophets—the entire world would be erased.

dialogue.content:
"The fragment in your body will sooner or later bring you disaster." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried no emotion. "Tianqing Sect's former Master Ling Yuan, Xuanwu Sect's Han Lie, the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path... every one of them covets the secrets of the Tianji Record."

"And your sister—Chen Nian—was taken by the Holy Sect precisely because she holds the third key that can open my chains sealed within her body."

Chen Ji's hand clenched tightly, his knuckles turning white.

This was his weakness.

And the Heavenly Eye had stepped precisely on it.

text.content:
Within the Mental Sea, the Heavenly Eye waited quietly. That giant eye woven from laws did not urge nor threaten—it simply watched Chen Ji, like a predator gazing at prey that had finally fallen into its trap.

No, that wasn't right.

Chen Ji coldly sneered in his heart. What it awaited was not the surrender of prey, but rather...

He raised his head, voice hoarse: "What if I refuse?"

"Then refuse." The Heavenly Eye's answer was unexpectedly calm. "You have the right to refuse. But I will also retract my earlier promises—regarding how to break the chess game, regarding your sister's whereabouts, regarding... the true secret of the Tianji Record."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's words left Chen Ji in a dilemma—on one side was a terrifying existence from ten thousand years ago, on the other was the truth that might reset heaven and earth. He had to make a choice.

choices.description: Reach cooperation with the Heavenly Eye, get the intelligence first—as for whether to fulfill the promise later, that's for later
choices.visible_cost: May deepen the entanglement with the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Gain key clues to breaking the chess game, hope to save sister
choices.risk_hint: Negotiating with the tiger, cost unknown

dialogue.content:
After a long silence, Chen Ji slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air: "Very well. I agree to cooperate with Senior. But let me be clear—I only agree to help search for the keys. As for whether they can be gathered, whether I will help Senior break the chains, that depends on whether the intelligence Senior provides is worth it."

He raised his head, eyes sparkling with brilliant light: "After all, as Senior said, you and I are not enemies. The foundation of cooperation is equality."

flags_set: 与天道之眼达成临时合作

choices.description: Accept cooperation, but must first obtain news of Chen Nian—this is the bottom line, non-negotiable
choices.visible_reward: Ensure sister's safety line takes priority
choices.risk_hint: May anger the Heavenly Eye, negotiation breaks down

dialogue.content:
A coldness never seen before flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. The mask of the废物 disciple completely fell away at this moment, revealing that extremely cold face.

"Chen Nian." He only said two words, yet they weighed like a thousand tons.

"Where is my sister? How is she now?"

His voice was very calm, so calm that even the Heavenly Eye paused slightly.

"Cooperation is possible. But this is my bottom line—what you want me to do is negotiable, but news about her must be told to me immediately."

flags_set: 与天道之眼达成临时合作

dialogue.content:
"...Interesting."

Within the Heavenly Eye's pupil, those countless stars suddenly gathered into a beam of light, illuminating Chen Ji's face.

"Your sister is still alive at this moment. She is imprisoned in the deepest part of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, at the 'Heavenly Fate Altar,' serving as the vessel to awaken the third key. As long as she is alive, the key cannot be opened."

Chen Ji's heart surged violently.

"But precisely because of this—she is currently safe. The Holy Sect will not harm her easily."

text.content:
Safe.

These two words were like a warm current flowing into his heart. But immediately, an even greater chill followed—why had the Heavenly Eye revealed Chen Nian's news so easily?

Was it showing goodwill? Or a warning?

Chen Ji lowered his eyes, hiding all emotions at the bottom of his heart. The timid posture of the废物 disciple returned to him once again: "Then... what about the first key and the second key?"

"The first is in Ling Yuan's hands—do you think he accepted you as a disciple for what reason?"

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

"The second is within the Xuanwu Sect's secret realm. That genius named Han Lie is searching for it. As for the third..." The Heavenly Eye's voice paused slightly, "is within your sister."

All the clues, at this moment, connected into a massive web.

Ling Yuan accepting him as a disciple was for the Tianji Record Fragment—just as Mo Xiansheng had warned before.

Han Lie's confrontation with him might not merely be sect rivalry from the beginning, but a collision between two keys.

And Chen Nian... from beginning to end, was the most critical piece in this chess game.

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes.

When he opened them again, there was no fluctuation in those eyes. Only the corner of his mouth slightly curved into a cold smile—that was the cold smile belonging to a chess player.

dialogue.content:
"Since you understand, then go."

The Heavenly Eye's voice gradually faded, and that giant eye woven from laws also began slowly closing.

"The Nine Yin Forbidden Grounds, the deepest part of Tianqing Sect. That is where I am sealed, and also... the starting point for you to seek answers."

"When you gather the three keys and open the seal—that is when we shall meet again."

"I hope by then, you can still be this composed."

In those final words was a meaningful smile.

Then, that eye vanished completely.

text.content:
Chen Ji violently opened his eyes.

He found himself still kneeling in the original secret chamber, the Tianji Record Fragment lying quietly in his palm, as if nothing had happened.

But he knew, everything was different now.

He looked down at the fragment in his palm, a self-mocking arc forming at the corner of his mouth: "A prisoner from ten thousand years ago, a chess game ten thousand years later... I thought I was the chess player, but I am merely a piece on the board."

He stood up and tucked the fragment into his chest.

"But that's alright."

In the废物 disciple's eyes, a light that had never burned before was blazing.

"Since we're all chess pieces, then I will overturn this entire game—including the chess player."

He pushed open the chamber door, at the end of the dim corridor stood the dilapidated housing where Tianqing Sect's Servant Disciples lived. The night wind brushed past, bringing a hint of coolness.

Chen Ji took a deep breath,收敛 all emotions on his face. The timidity and mediocrity of the废物 disciple returned once more, as if that existence who had confronted the Heavenly Eye just now was merely an illusion.

But his footsteps were more determined than when he came.

The Nine Yin Forbidden Grounds, he must go.

Not to liberate the Heavenly Eye—but to find that key, to save Chen Nian, to...

See what else lies behind this chess game.

However, the instant Chen Ji walked out of the secret chamber, a familiar aura suddenly appeared behind him.

"You went there again."

That voice was cold as frost, carrying a trace of suppressed anger.

Chen Ji's footsteps paused. He turned his head to see Su Qingyao standing beneath the moonlight, the robes of the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow shimmering with a faint glow in the night. Her gaze was firmly fixed on Chen Ji, eyes containing scrutiny, worry, and a trace of... concern she herself had not noticed.

The third time.

This was the third time she had come infinitely close to the truth.

Chen Ji sighed silently in his heart, but on his face appeared the particular sycophantic smile unique to废物 disciples: "Senior Sister Su, it's so late, why are you here?"

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's intuition pointed to the truth once again. Chen Ji must find a way to resolve this crisis while not exposing the secret of the Heavenly Eye.

choices.description: Continue playing the废物 disciple, find an excuse to muddle through—but Su Qingyao clearly won't be easily fooled
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily keep the secret, buy time
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's patience is wearing thin

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji scratched his head, looking innocent: "Senior Sister Su misunderstands, Junior Brother just... just couldn't sleep and came out for some fresh air. That secret room was discovered by Junior Brother by chance, there's nothing inside—"

"Enough." Su Qingyao cut him off, her gaze sharp as a blade, "Do you take me for a fool?"

choices.description: Tell Su Qingyao about the Nine Nether Forbidden Grounds and Ling Yuan, but don't mention the Heavenly Eye—use the truth to conceal deeper secrets
choices.visible_cost: Su Qingyao might insist on accompanying, increasing variables
choices.visible_reward: Deepen the bond with Su Qingyao, lay groundwork for the 'Shared Fate' buff
choices.risk_hint: Trust is a double-edged sword, might be used against you

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment. When he raised his head again, the废物 disciple's sycophancy had vanished, replaced by a depth she had never witnessed.

"Senior Sister, there are things I shouldn't say. But since you asked..." he paused, "Elder Ling Yuan isn't as straightforward as he appears. The Nine Nether Forbidden Grounds hold secrets, and I... must see for myself."

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶已得知九幽禁地的部分真相

text.content:
Under the moonlight, Su Qingyao gazed quietly at this废物 disciple junior brother she once thought worthless.

What did she see?

Those eyes held no废物's timidity, no feigned sycophancy—only unfathomable shrewdness, and... a hint of exhaustion she had never witnessed.

What did this youth truly carry?

Complex emotions surged within Su Qingyao. She longed to question, to investigate, to tear away that mask and see the truth—

Yet she feared.

Feared that once she saw clearly, she would be forced to make a choice.

After a long while, Su Qingyao let out a soft sigh.

"Very well." She turned, her moon-white skirt swaying gently in the night breeze, "If you don't wish to speak, I won't ask."

She took a few steps forward, then suddenly stopped: "But Chen Ji—remember, whatever you're doing, don't die."

As her words fell, her figure vanished into the night.

Chen Ji stood motionless, gazing toward where she disappeared, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips.

"Su Qingyao..." he murmured softly, "You're the only person in the Tianqing Sect I cannot see through."

Night wind howled, ruffling his thin garments.

Tomorrow, he would enter the Nine Nether Forbidden Grounds.

And this journey... might be one from which he never returns.

Chen Ji returned to his dilapidated dwelling, yet he did not rest.

He drew out the Tianji Record Fragment from his breast, examining it carefully under the moonlight filtering through the window. The characters on the ancient scroll remained obscure and difficult, but now, upon closer inspection, he perceived meanings of a different nature.

Master Mo's remnant soul within the fragment quivered slightly, as if wishing to speak, yet remained perpetually silent.

Chen Ji did not press for answers, merely tucking the fragment back into his breast, closing his eyes to begin regulating his breath.

Deep within the Tianqing Sect, the entrance to the Nine Nether Forbidden Grounds awaited him.

The first key lay within Ling Yuan's possession.

And he—must find a breakthrough right under that old fox's very eyes.

This night was destined to be sleepless.
